text: The Oceania Hotels website is published by SAS SOFIBRA (RCS Brest 997635123, 5 rue Colbert, Brest) and describes Oceania Hotels as a Breton family company founded in 1975. The company register lists F.B.I. (SIREN 343493318, SA, 5 rue Colbert, Brest) as Président de SAS of SOFIBRA, and lists on F.B.I.'s board Gwenola Deguerre (Branellec) as Présidente du conseil d'administration et directeur général, Gurvan Branellec and Rozenn Dumon (Branellec) as directeurs généraux délégués, and François Branellec as administrateur.
short: Oceania Hotels is published by SOFIBRA, whose Président is F.B.I., a holding whose board is made up of Branellec family members.
